plugin.note: Requires Death Plateau and Watch the birdie. Use ranged or magic against flying Aviansie; salamanders and halberds are direct-target exceptions. Wear Armadyl-aligned protection in God Wars Dungeon. Kree'arra is the slower boss-profit alternative.

requirements: 60 Agility or 60 Strength to unlock Watch the birdie
Armadyl-aligned God Wars Dungeon protection item
Hard Fremennik Diary for noted adamantite bars from normal God Wars Dungeon Aviansie
70 Ranged, a crossbow, and a mith grapple for Kree'arra access
mechanics: Aviansie are Armadylean followers, so Armadyl-aligned items make them tolerant in the God Wars Dungeon.
Aviansie have an increased sense of danger and will retaliate if attacked, even if already fighting another monster.
Aviansie fly too high for ordinary melee and can normally only be harmed with ranged or magic.
Salamanders and halberds are exceptions because they can directly target flying Aviansie.
Normal God Wars Dungeon Aviansie only drop noted adamantite bars after the Hard Fremennik Diary.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon Aviansie drop noted adamantite bars regardless of diary completion, but the area is multicombat Wilderness.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Use ranged or magic against regular Aviansie after unlocking Watch the birdie, with Armadyl protection for God Wars Dungeon tolerance.
recommendedFor: players deciding between normal Aviansie, Wilderness Aviansie, and Kree'arra
steps: Confirm Watch the birdie is unlocked before taking Aviansie assignments.
Wear an Armadyl-aligned God item so Armadylean followers are tolerant.
Use ranged or magic because flying Aviansie cannot normally be damaged with melee.
Pick up adamantite bars, runite limbs, ensouled aviansie heads, and poisoned rune daggers when worthwhile.
Use Kree'arra only when choosing boss profit or boss completion over a regular Aviansie task.
risks: Regular Aviansie are generally unpopular, so many players keep the assignment toggled off unless killing Kree'arra.
Wilderness God Wars Dungeon adds player-killing risk.
notes: Spiritual warriors, spiritual rangers, and spiritual mages aligned to Armadyl do not count as Aviansie task alternatives.

methods.label: Normal God Wars Dungeon
methods.summary: Kill regular Aviansie in the God Wars Dungeon with ranged or magic while using Armadyl protection.
recommendedFor: players with Hard Fremennik Diary for noted bars
steps: Enter the God Wars Dungeon after Death Plateau access.
Wear Armadyl protection to avoid Armadylean aggression where possible.
Attack regular Aviansie with ranged or magic.
Use high alchemy on runite limbs and poisoned rune daggers if staying longer.
Expect adamantite bars to be noted only after Hard Fremennik Diary completion.
notes: Killing regular Aviansie contributes to Armadylean kill count.
There are 36 Aviansie listed in the normal God Wars Dungeon comparison row.

methods.label: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
methods.summary: Use the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon only when accepting multicombat player-killing risk in exchange for noted adamantite bars without diary completion.
recommendedFor: players without Hard Fremennik Diary who still want noted adamantite bars
requiredOrKeyItems: One-click teleport that works from the chosen Wilderness level
steps: Bring reduced-risk gear because the location is in the Wilderness.
Keep a one-click teleport available where possible.
Kill Aviansie with ranged or magic and prioritise noted adamantite bars.
Leave immediately if player-killing risk becomes unacceptable.
risks: The location is multicombat and dangerous because of player killing.
Risk constraints may force less than optimal gear.
notes: There are 8 Aviansie listed in the Wilderness God Wars Dungeon comparison row.

methods.label: Kree'arra boss alternative
methods.summary: Kill Kree'arra and his bodyguards on an Aviansie task when choosing boss profit over a normal Aviansie task.
recommendedFor: players who toggled Aviansie on for Kree'arra
requiredOrKeyItems: Crossbow that can fire a mith grapple
Zarosian protection item for Nex banking
steps: Use an ecumenical key to avoid wasting time on Armadyl kill count.
Reserve inventory space for a crossbow that can fire a mith grapple and for the mith grapple.
Bring an emergency teleport as usual for Kree'arra.
Gather Zarosian kill count before starting the trip if planning to bank at Nex.
Use Kree'arra-specific gear and follow the dedicated Kree'arra strategy for the fight.
risks: Kree'arra is a slower way to complete Aviansie tasks than killing regular Aviansie.
Returning from Nex banking can be dangerous without a Zarosian item and prepared kill count.
notes: Kree'arra and his bodyguards count as alternatives for an Aviansie task.
With max mage gear, an Eldritch nightmare staff, and optional Lightbearer, players can often complete full tasks at Kree'arra without banking.
Armadylean spiritual warriors, rangers, and mages do not count as Aviansie task alternatives.
Choose the named monster in the catalogue to use its dedicated strategy, equipment, location and preparation requirements.

advisor.coverageStatus: Task alternative reference; choose the dedicated monster strategy for its complete equipment and requirements

methods.label: Reanimated Aviansie alternative
methods.summary: Reanimated aviansie can be killed for task progress, but obtaining ensouled aviansie heads is usually inconvenient.
recommendedFor: players who already have ensouled aviansie heads
steps: Use this option only when ensouled aviansie heads are already available.
Reanimate and kill the Aviansie for task progress.
Return to normal Aviansie or Kree'arra when heads run out.
notes: The task page notes this can be troublesome because ensouled heads are not commonly obtained from regular Aviansie kills.

styleOptions.name: Magic
notes: Valid against flying Aviansie and the page's Kree'arra alternative with max mage gear.

styleOptions.name: Direct-target exceptions
notes: Salamanders and halberds are noted exceptions to the normal ranged-or-magic restriction because they can directly target flying Aviansie.
